caseName: Printing Specialties & Paper Converters Union, Local 388 v. LeBaron
caseNameFull: Printing Specialties & Paper Converters Union, Local 388, A. F. of L. v. LeBaron, Regional Director, National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: J. Albert Woll, Herbert S. Thatcher and James A. Glenn for petitioners.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit is dismissed on motion of counsel for the petitioners.
